intent: To demonstrate that in comparable international contexts, teachers earn a pay ratio close to that of college graduates, contrasting with the lower ratio in the United States.

requirements.question: Is the full top-to-bottom ranking required, or only the USA bottom position?
Must the video show USA below every other entity, or only below the OECD aggregate?
Is the quantitative USA-OECD gap required, or just the qualitative lower-than-OECD comparison?

units.claim: Germany has the highest relative value, 0.6667, and the United States has the lowest, 0.4333, among the eight listed entities.
accept: The relative ranking runs from Germany at 0.6667 down to the USA at 0.4333.
Germany is top and the USA is bottom.
The endpoints of the ordering are Germany 0.6667 and the USA 0.4333.
The USA anchors the bottom of the ranking, below all others.
units.evidence: The ordering must visibly place DEU at or near the top and USA at the bottom.

units.claim: The United States relative value, 0.4333, is lower than every other listed entity and the OECD aggregate; the next-lowest values are New Zealand and OECD at 0.5867.
accept: USA is below all non-US entities, including OECD and New Zealand at 0.5867.
Every other entity exceeds the USA relative value.
The USA is the sole bottom value; OECD and NZL are the closest above it at 0.5867.
No other listed entity is as low as the USA.
units.evidence: The USA mark must be visibly lower than every other listed entity, including NZL and OECD.

units.claim: The relative gap between the United States value, 0.4333, and the OECD aggregate value, 0.5867, is 0.1534.
accept: USA is about 0.15 lower than OECD.
OECD's relative value exceeds USA by 0.1534.
The USA-OECD difference is 0.1534 on the relative measure.
units.evidence: A comparison or gap annotation between USA and OECD must be visible, or the two values must be directly comparable.

optional_valid: Highlight the tie between New Zealand and OECD at 0.5867.
Show Finland at 0.6533 and Germany at 0.6667 as the top two non-US values.
Show the full ordered list: DEU 0.6667, FIN 0.6533, ISR 0.6400, AUS 0.6267, UK 0.6133, NZL/OECD 0.5867, USA 0.4333.
Use the USA-OECD contrast as the main comparative frame.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded

clip_hardcase.reason: The reference SVG has no explicit data-role=bar mark, so visual-unit reconstruction needs manual review.

hardcases.handling: Requires human visual inspection before semantic scoring.
